entities.name: Crkva Svetog proroka Ilije Marićka
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Church of Saint Elijah is a Serbian Orthodox wooden church located in the village of Marićka of the Prijedor municipality of the Republika Srpska, Bosnia and Herzegovina. Dedicated to Saint Elijah, it was constructed in 1870.
